parameters.name: Domains
parameters.description: The list of domain names added to WAF.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: PunishType
parameters.description:
The penalty type. Valid values:

- **beian** (default): ICP filing center.

- **punishCenter**: penalty center.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region of the WAF instance. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.
